tool_args.rationale: The signatures and authorized branch rule support the five-parameter coupled siphon-memory ODE. Current five rows leave its parameters underidentified, so acquire the available extra trajectory batch to reach the advised minimum before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the 5-parameter spatio-temporal siphon-memory ODE from the five initial rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five observations do not adequately identify the coupled ODE parameters; the verified guidance calls for at least eight trajectory rows.
It is explicitly irrelevant to the target law and adds cost without resolving identifiability.
The supplied guidance says this is needed for narrow s_grad coverage; the observed span is 1.95 and narrow collinearity is explicitly false.
